title: Influence of the Gotsman–Linial extremizer
statement: For nonnegative integers $m$ and $k$, and any coordinate $i$ of the $(m+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube, the influence of coordinate $i$ for the Gotsman–Linial extremizer with parameters $m+1$ and $k$ is $$\\sum_{j=0}^{k-1}\\frac{\\binom{m}{\\lfloor((m+1)-k)/2\\rfloor+j}}{2^m}.$$
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate of the $(m+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube
